findings.body: A cache probe with `cache.storeReady` and `geometry.streamComplete` done but no `scene.finalize` can still return ready if the logs retain a previous `[GeomStream] finalizeStreamingAsync complete` line: the unchanged renderer check accepts `legacy.renderer` even when a probe exists. The new cache route therefore need not wait for its actual scene finalization.

This assertion remains green if the scene-finalization requirement is removed: the canvas is not ready until 450, after the configured finalization at 350. It cannot detect a cached load returning ready without waiting for `scene.finalize`.
